text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic as artificial intelligence plays a bigger role in our daily lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from the data they are trained on. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups of people. Fairness means making sure AI treats everyone equally. Privacy is also a serious issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. In addition, transparency matters: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create clear rules and protect users.
